decisions.reason: 보내야 할 is a letter that needs sending; BASE’s “delivered” over-specifies the messenger’s act.
벽을 넘어섰다는 것이 has no 정말; the confirmation already sits in “So it was true.”
“As an outstanding Peak master” carries the 인 그는 + 한눈에 causal link; SOL’s bare appositive is stiffer, not better.
말도 안 되다 is that the situation is absurd; BASE adds “to explain” without support.
Glossary binds 삼류 as Third Rate; SOL’s “third-rate” reads as an ordinary adjective, not the rank.
십여 년 is about ten years; “more than a decade” overstates 여, and “until … ago” is awkward.
The narrator’s gloss is a common noun, matching P29’s lowercase “guild”; capital G treats it as a title.
오오 is an elongated impressed sound; “Ooh” fits that better than a flat “Oh.”
거리도 가깝네요 is spoken and includes 도; BASE’s “fairly” hedges 가깝다.
기운 좋은 is stamina/energy in the horses, not generic strength.
입 털다 is Taekyung talking after gathering the servants; BASE lectures Mujin, SOL makes the servants the speakers.
decisions.replacement: “There’s no high or low in honest work. Are you looking down on servants now? Should I round up every servant in the Jin Family of Taiyuan and give them an earful?”

decisions.reason: 하십쇼 is wheedling “please stop”; BASE’s barked “stop already!” hardens Mujin’s line.
Restores 이미 on the familiar sight; BASE drops it.
“Left at the water’s edge” keeps 내놓은 and matches the P78 callback; BASE’s “by” is weaker.
Restores 나도 (“too”) and 내놓은; BASE drops both.
상당한 친분 is naturally “close ties”; SOL’s “considerable ties” is stiff.
뭐, 그렇다는 말이죠 is a shrug (“Well”), not “Of course.”
황당한 is incredulous and 박살난 is smashed; bewildered/mangled miss both.
텐데 is conjectural; “can’t have been” keeps that, while SOL states it as fact.
빠져나갔다 is slipping out of the room, not a generic “left.”
옆구리 on a horse is the flank, not just the side.
Restores 묵직한 and 우다다다; BASE’s generic “running…burdened” drops both.
데려가 주세요 is a please-request; BASE drops the 주세요.
They are inferring from his line, so “Sounds like” fits 것 같은데요 better than “Looks like.”
데려가 주세요 is again a please-request; BASE drops the 주세요.
사백여 is some four hundred, not “more than four hundred.”
사백여 is ~400; BASE overstates with “more than,” and SOL’s “four-hundred-some” is unnatural.
decisions.replacement: Their leader had given them permission to run wild as they pleased. The four hundred or so mounted bandits belonging to the Heavenly Wind Band trembled with excitement.

decisions.reason: 오합지졸 is a contemptuous rabble; “mobs” beats generic “forces.”
Keeps 한솥밥; BASE genericizes to “shared meals” and adds “the men before him.”
Same 사백여 problem as H027: BASE overstates, SOL’s “four-hundred-some” is unnatural.
decisions.replacement: The four hundred or so mounted bandits, brimming with excitement, had just turned their horses south when—

decisions.reason: 카랑카랑한 is a clear, ringing voice, not merely shrill.
시리도록 is icy/cold-stinging white; SOL’s “piercing” drops the cold.
